title: Constructibility of the specified finite-coefficient heart realization
statement:
For a Noetherian scheme X and a finite discrete topological field A, an embedded discrete module M is constant-model constructible exactly when its image under the actual finiteHeartRealization of [lem-sfb-embedded-finite-heart-realization] is intrinsically constructible. This concerns one module sheaf and asserts no monoidal structure, derived compatibility or equivalence of categories.

Exact Lean assertion:
theorem finiteHeartConstructibility
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (A : Type) [Field A]
    [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A] [Finite A] [DiscreteTopology A]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (discreteObj A) X)) :
    IsConstantModelConstructible (discreteObj A) X M ↔
      Scheme.IsConstructibleProEtaleModuleSheaf X (ULift.{u, 0} A)
        ((finiteHeartRealization X A).obj M)

source.place: First paragraph, clauses (1) and (2); Stacks Tags 099L, 03ET, 00YV, 06YQ and 09AL.

proof.text: The canonical finiteScalarPointMap is invertible by the finite-clopen-fibre local bijection used in finiteHeartRealization. Postcomposition with ULift.up and ULift.down gives an explicit ring-sheaf isomorphism from the Type-0 continuous coefficients to continuous coefficients in the scheme universe. Compose these point maps and pull back to X. Restriction along this coefficient isomorphism preserves and reflects finite constant local models: transport the finite free presentations and their cokernels and use comapUpperStarIso and mapModComapIso on every cover member and stratum. Apply the proved generic helpers constantModel_comap_iff and constructible_iso from the integral heart closure module. This step uses only their general coefficient-isomorphism section, not its integral Serre theorem.

Choose a normalized finite-discrete Encoding for ULift A. Apply the already proved constructible_comparison in FiniteDiscreteEncodingConstructibility to the transported module. Noetherian X is qcqs, so ordinaryConstructible reduces to ordinaryStratified. Identify ordinaryLocalModel with IsFiniteLocallyConstant: lift a small cover index into Type (u+1) in one direction, and restrict the larger cover to a Type-u subcover using Mathlib Precoverage.Small for propQCPrecoverage in the other. The finite modules and their model isomorphisms are unchanged. Thus the normalized fixed-scalar image is constructible exactly when the original embedded module is constant-model constructible.

The normalized fixed-scalar image retains the original additive sections; its underlying additive sheaf comparison is the identity. For the specified finiteHeartRealization, intrinsicRealization_restriction removes the final associated-module-sheaf realization after constant-scalar restriction. The proved integralModel_fixed_forget identifies section-action followed by scalar restriction with the underlying internal module. Scalar extension along finiteScalarMap is restriction along its inverse, so its underlying sheaf is also the original one. Compose these additive comparisons and forget to sheaves of sets.

Apply the proved integralModel_fixed_constructible_transfer helper from IntegralModelsGenerators in both directions to the underlying-set sheaf isomorphism. Its proof pulls the isomorphism to each stratum, refines finite constant set models by the finite scalar-action table, and composes the covering families. Both coefficient rings here are finite, so it applies in both directions. Finally apply proEtaleModuleRestriction_constructible_iff to the actual heart realization. This last existing theorem handles positive stratum counts on the empty scheme. Compose the four equivalences.

proof_origin.place: First paragraph, clauses (1) and (2); finite coefficient scalar comparison. Uses the proved normalized constructibility comparison and the proved finite-action underlying-sheaf transfer.
